reason: Four related defects in the legacy relation arrays (Finding.asset_ids/evidence_ids, Observation.evidence_ids, Report.finding_ids/observation_ids, Evidence.finding_id), which every GET/LIST projects from ResourceRelationRow edges. (1) upload_evidence wrote Evidence.finding_id and Finding.evidence_ids only into the raw payloads and never created the EVIDENCE SUPPORTS FINDING edge, so evidence linked at upload showed evidence_ids: [] and finding_id: null on every API read; the upload now writes the edge in the same store transaction (ResourceRelationService.sync_legacy_edges on the new Evidence). (2) Any PATCH/PUT of a finding, note or report built its candidate from the raw payload and _sync_legacy_edges deleted every controlled edge before re-adding what the arrays said, so edges created through the relations API vanished on an unrelated title edit and edges deleted through it came back; make_patch now starts from relation_service.project_legacy(current) so untouched arrays reflect the current edges, sync_legacy_edges reconciles as a delta (existing rows keep their ids, only named/unnamed edges are added/removed), and the controlled-edge filter is narrowed to the edges the arrays actually project so a note's REFERENCES edge to a knowledge source survives note edits. (13) Duplicate ids in a legacy array hit the unique edge constraint and surfaced as a misleading 409 'entity already exists' on POST and an unhandled IntegrityError 500 on PATCH; _desired_legacy_edges now rejects repeats with a ValueError (422 naming the field and ids) before any write, and replace_legacy_entity maps a racing IntegrityError to a 409. (19) project_legacy read at most 500 edges through list_relations, so a report with more inclusions rendered truncated finding_ids and a GET->PUT round trip deleted the surplus; projection and sync now page through every controlled edge. tests/v3/test_relations.py adds four tests (delta sync across PATCH/PUT and relations-API delete, note-to-source retention, duplicate rejection on POST/PATCH/PUT with no write, 505-edge projection and round trip), tests/v3/test_evidence.py adds the upload read-path test with a same-transaction rollback check, and tests/v3/test_api_crud_validation.py adds the projected-PATCH test (confirming a finding whose only evidence link is a relations-API edge). All six fail on origin/main and pass here; the other 50 tests in those files still pass.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/api.py) does not exercise the relation projection of findings, notes or reports nor evidence upload linking; the one api.py change is a one-line projection of the PATCH base entity inside the generic CRUD route and the Python tests drive it directly through TestClient. No full suites.
